krieg.einsatz.cyber.name: Cyberattacks
krieg.einsatz.cyber.text: Attacks on the enemy's networks, power grid and command systems: hardly any own losses, no ground taken. Their strength depends on the Cyber Security agency.
welle_k1.beg.vollmacht: Under the standing authorisation of the Grand National Assembly, the operation against {land} begins.
welle_k1.eingefroren.log_linie: The conflict with {land} freezes: Türkiye holds {regionen} without a treaty.
welle_k1.eingefroren.text_linie: Without a peace treaty the line stays where it is: {regionen} {n, plural, one {remains} other {remain}} under Turkish control. The troops demobilise, tension with {land} stays high. A treaty can follow later.
welle_k1.erschoepft.warum: The other side proposes “{paket}” and accepts it ({aussicht}%).
welle_k1.erschoepft.sieg: It would accept a victor's peace with reparations at {aussicht} (needed: {noetig}).
welle_k1.fern.erreicht: Aim achieved: the other side is ready to negotiate.
welle_k1.fern.kipp.text: Türkiye has the upper hand in the exchange of strikes with {land} (position {front}).
welle_k1.fern.kipp.warum: There is no ground to gain; the pressure on the other side is growing.
welle_k1.fern.lage: Position in the exchange of strikes
welle_k1.fern.mittel_hilfe: No land front: no territory can be taken. The means wear down the enemy's endurance while our own losses stay low.
welle_k1.fern.satz: No common border with {land}: no ground war, no territory. The outcome is deterrence, concessions or a ceasefire.
welle_k1.fern.wochen: Achievable after {noetig, plural, one {one week} other {# weeks}} of war at the earliest; now week {jetzt}.
welle_k1.fern.ziel_bedingung: Position from {front} · enemy support up to {uhr}
welle_k1.fern.ziel.waffenstillstand.name: Ceasefire
welle_k1.fern.ziel.waffenstillstand.text: The guns are to fall silent, with no further demand. The easiest aim to reach.
welle_k1.fern.ziel.abschreckung.name: Deterrence
welle_k1.fern.ziel.abschreckung.text: The other side is to hold still: security guarantees, and Türkiye's deterrence grows.
welle_k1.fern.ziel.zugestaendnisse.name: Concessions
welle_k1.fern.ziel.zugestaendnisse.text: The other side is to pay and give guarantees. Requires clear superiority.
welle_k1.h.drohkulisse: Build up a show of force
welle_k1.h.drohkulisse.hinweis: Troops to the border and a public demand on {land}. From then on the clock runs until a deployment is possible; markets and capitals take note.
welle_k1.h.erst_ultimatum: First the ultimatum: {land} must be given the chance to back down.
welle_k1.h.paket_nein: {land} refuses: willingness {aussicht}, {noetig} needed. The calculation is shown on the package.
welle_k1.h.vollmacht: Order the deployment under the authorisation
welle_k1.h.vollmacht.hinweis: The Grand National Assembly's authorisation covers {land} until {bis, date, lang}: no new vote. The President decides scope, place and timing.
welle_k1.h.vollmacht_abgelaufen: The standing authorisation expired on {bis, date, lang}.
welle_k1.h.waffenruhe_ziel: The war aim is achieved: {land} accepts a ceasefire and puts a package on the table.
welle_k1.krise.eben: A confrontation with this country has only just ended. A new crisis will not be credible for at least a month.
welle_k1.krise.erklaerung: Conflicts also arise on their own, from a tension of {anlage} or through incidents. Mediation and calming remain open on every rung.
welle_k1.krise.preis_aufschlag: Calm relations (below {ab}): a pretext costs more. Standing {ansehen} · trust ({land}) {vertrauen}
welle_k1.krise.warum: Costs {pk} capital, standing {ansehen}, trust {vertrauen}. The tension becomes a confrontation; the next rung is the show of force.
welle_k1.leiter.ohne_ultimatum: If Türkiye is attacked, or when assisting a partner, there is no ultimatum.
welle_k1.leiter.start.fern: Remote conflict: no common border with {land}. Air, sea, proxies and cyber instead of a land front, and no territory.
welle_k1.leiter.start.land: Once the crisis is running, you choose the justification and the target area here in the file.
welle_k1.paket.linie.name: Peace along the line
welle_k1.paket.linie.text: Türkiye keeps what it holds as a security zone. No reparations, mutual guarantees.
welle_k1.paket.fern_abschreckung.name: Deterrence peace
welle_k1.paket.fern_abschreckung.text: Ceasefire with security guarantees; both sides withdraw their forces. No territory.
welle_k1.paket.fern_zugestaendnisse.name: Peace with concessions
welle_k1.paket.fern_zugestaendnisse.text: The other side pays compensation and gives guarantees; both withdraw their forces. No territory.
welle_k1.pakete.balken: The enemy's willingness; the mark is the acceptance threshold
welle_k1.pakete.offen: {land} accepts a package at a willingness of {n} or more.
welle_k1.pakete.ziel: The war aim is achieved: {land} is negotiating.
welle_k1.recht.erlass_sitzung: The Grand National Assembly is in session (recess runs from 1 July to 30 September). Even after an attack it decides, in an urgent sitting; the President may act alone only during the recess (Art. 92(2)).
welle_k1.sicherheit.ziel_keins: No target area chosen: the border belt applies.
welle_k1.x.drohkulisse: Türkiye builds up a show of force against {land}.
welle_k1.x.drohkulisse.warum: Troops at the border, the demand is public. A deployment can follow in {tage} days at the earliest.
welle_k1.x.vollmacht: The President orders the deployment against {land} under the authorisation (valid until {bis, date, lang}).
welle_k1.x.vollmacht.warum: Article 92 of the Constitution: the standing authorisation leaves scope, place and timing to the President, so no new vote is needed.
welle_k1.ziel.bis_dahin: Once the war aim is achieved, the other side becomes ready to negotiate and proposes a package.
welle_k1.ziel.erreicht_am: War aim achieved on {datum}: the other side is ready to negotiate.
welle_k1.ziel.log: War aim against {land} achieved: the other side proposes “{paket}”.
welle_k1.ziel.raum_standard: Without a choice, the border belt applies ({n} regions).
welle_k1.ziel.text: {land} can no longer deny Türkiye its aim and offers talks: “{paket}”. You decide whether the guns fall silent or Türkiye pushes on.
welle_k1.ziel.warum: An achieved aim makes the enemy ready to negotiate. Pushing on costs home support and lives.
welle_k1.verlauf.sockel: The declared war aim keeps escalation at {sockel} or above until you calm the situation or mediation succeeds.
welle_k1.pakete.angebot_ab: On {datum, date, lang} {land} will put forward its own proposal, which it is sure to accept.
welle_k1.paket.fern_nachgeben.name: Peace with Turkish concessions
welle_k1.paket.fern_nachgeben.text: Türkiye pays compensation and withdraws its forces. No territory, but a visible climb-down.
welle_k1.ausgang.eingefroren: Frozen without a treaty: the ceasefire line holds, the dispute remains.
welle_k1.ausgang.sieg: Peace concluded: Türkiye has achieved its war aim.
welle_k1.ausgang.weisser_frieden: Peace without a victor: both sides withdraw.
welle_k1.fern.erschoepft: The home front is exhausted: the exchange of strikes with {land} ends in a ceasefire.
welle_k1.fern.erschoepft.warum: Without a land front nothing collapses, but the country will no longer carry the war. The other side proposes “{paket}”.
